objective: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

description: Although I know my enemy well, I am a warrior, <name>. I cannot begin to tell you what this orb is capable of.
I know of a mage in Orgrimmar that will be able to tell us more about the orb. Take it to him.
completion: This orb is very powerful, but also very dangerous.
